source_revisions.equivalence: The submitted commit has identical Go source and tests to the measured final commit; it adds a changelog entry and squashes the patch history.

hardware: Apple M4, macOS 15.6.1, 16 GiB RAM; shared developer machine, no CPU affinity

server.connection: TCP gRPC over loopback, plaintext, bearer token

database.seed_method: public WriteSchema and WriteRelationships gRPC APIs
database.co_location: same host as server and load generator

fixtures.direct10: public user wildcard minus 10 named users
fixtures.chain5000: public wildcard minus 5000 users, then 10 different users
fixtures.group5000: public wildcard minus a group membership of 5000 users
fixtures.concrete: 1000 named members minus 500 named users; no wildcard

verification: Every measured lookup checks exact subject IDs, uniqueness, expected wildcard or explicit subjects, permissionship and absence of unexpected caveat metadata. All 96 fixture documents were also verified separately for each variant.

fixed_runs.request_pattern: 60 scheduled lookups at 10 per second, four workers, new server process per case, three rotated run orders
fixed_runs.latency: from scheduled arrival through complete gRPC response receipt; includes client queuing and excludes post-receipt exact-result validation
fixed_runs.churn_consistency: fully consistent; alternating unrelated permission additions/deletions target 20 writes/second; actual counts recorded
fixed_runs.snapshot_consistency: exact snapshot at seed revision, no concurrent writes; all 16 fixture documents warmed first
fixed_runs.controls: fully cached wildcard lookup and a non-wildcard concrete-subject lookup

metrics.allocation: difference in server go_memstats_alloc_bytes_total divided by successful lookups, includes concurrent writes and small metrics/background overhead
metrics.cpu: difference in server process_cpu_seconds_total divided by successful lookups, includes writes and background work
metrics.cache_hits: server dispatch lookup_subjects_from_cache_total / lookup_subjects_total; includes recursive calls
metrics.percentiles: p95 per run, summarized as median and range across three runs; only 60 requests per fixed-rate run

limits: synthetic input graphs, not customer traces
single server and single local PostgreSQL instance; no multi-node dispatch or remote-network latency
shared host; absolute latency and small differences vary
demonstrates the specified wildcard exclusion workload, not fleet-wide performance or billing savings
